prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. This is a PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE CONTACT SHEET, not a poster. Reference image gives strict Sol/Luna identities, material quality and proportions. Paint clean sophisticated hand-painted feather textures with soft dimensional lighting. Sol: warm slate-blue/ivory owl, SUN medallion, gold laurel cape. Luna: deep indigo/ivory owl, CRESCENT medallion, gold star cape. Both have a large round head, compact round body, tiny short feet only, bright amber eyes, TWO separate swept brow-feather clusters rooted at left/right outer eye corners. No central horn. No long legs. ANIMATION CONSISTENCY: exact same owl identity, head size, body size, lighting, medallion design and costume across ALL frames of each character. Fixed camera, same scale, same horizontal center and feet baseline within equal grid cells. No text, numbers, titles, letters, grid lines, borders, ground, cast shadows or scenery. REAL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha; NOT a painted checkerboard. If transparency cannot be returned, use an absolutely uniform solid light neutral gray RGB 224,224,224, never textured or checkerboard. Each entire owl and its effects fits inside its equal cell with at least 10% clear padding, no overlapping cells. No motion blur. Wing/cape anatomy: cape drapes from neck, wings move from side openings UNDER or beside cape, cape must not magically become anatomical wings. Make adjacent frames incremental and continuous, not different unrelated poses.Landscape sheet. EXACTLY SIX columns and TWO rows, twelve full-body owls. Top row Sol, bottom row Luna. Frames progress LEFT TO RIGHT within each row. Camera frontal slightly three-quarter, same fixed feet position. SOL SIX-FRAME LOOP: (1) relaxed alert eye contact, wings down, gentle curious head tilt; (2) eyes shift down toward chest while a small wing tip starts lifting; (3) wing tip smooths the laurel cape close against chest, head inclines only slightly; (4) last small smoothing stroke, no large wing fan; (5) wing returns down, eyes lift toward viewer; (6) settled alert eye contact, same pose as frame1 for seamless repeat. Sol never closes both eyes in sleep. LUNA SIX-FRAME LOOP: (1) calm awake neutral stance; (2) wing tip makes a small smoothing stroke on star cape while looking down; (3) wing folds back down, head becomes gently heavy; (4) eyes softly closed, chin dips a little into fluffy chest, body settles just a little, small gold 'z' above shoulder separate from brow; (5) eyelids halfway reopening, head rising gently, z gone; (6) calm awake neutral stance matching frame1. Luna is endearingly drowsy, not collapsed. Keep grooming motion small enough to connect comfortably with slow native idle timing. Each frame must be full-body including both tiny feet.
